steps.en: Install into your harness with the npm CLI
steps.zh: 用 npm CLI 装进你的 harness

steps.en: Inject the ~50-line arming-thought kernel at every session start
steps.zh: 每次会话启动注入约 50 行的武装思想 kernel

steps.en: Assign work as usual, or call one method directly
steps.zh: 照常派活，或直接点一个方法

steps.en: Load the matching method skill only when clearly applicable; direct tasks load nothing
steps.zh: 仅在明确适用时加载对应方法，直接执行类不加载

steps.en: Dispatch read-only investigators and fresh-context critics when evidence is due
steps.zh: 该拿证据时派只读调查员与新鲜上下文批评者

value.en: A thinking discipline — investigate first, main contradiction, verified means done — live from session start
value.zh: 先调查、抓主要矛盾、验证过才算完成——会话一开始就生效的思维纪律

sources: README.md main (fetched 2026-09-28): 安装 — npx qiushi-skill install --target claude-code --scope user; 使用方式 — arming-thought kernel (~50 lines) auto-injected at session start; 手动命令入口 — /contradiction-analysis, /investigation-first, ...; agents/ — investigator (read-only, facts/inferences/unknowns report), self-critic (fresh context)
